services.title: Managed Detection & Response
services.intro: Threats don't clock out at 5pm. Neither do we. Our AI-driven MDR service hunts, identifies, and neutralizes threats around the clock — before they become breaches.
services.problemDescription: On average, attackers move through a network for 194 days before they're caught. Most organizations don't have the staff, tools, or threat intelligence to stop them. Security Dawgs MDR changes that equation — we find them before they find your data.

pillars.title: AI-Driven Precision
pillars.description: Our detection engine is trained on global threat intelligence and tuned to your specific environment. It cuts through thousands of daily alerts to surface only what actually matters — so your team acts on real threats, not noise.

pillars.title: Customized for You
pillars.description: Generic detection rules catch generic attacks. We map your unique environment — every asset, dependency, and relationship — and build detection logic around how your business actually operates. That's how we catch what others miss.

pillars.title: Real-Time Transparency
pillars.description: No black boxes. No monthly PDF you didn't read. Our live dashboards give you 24/7 visibility into your security posture, active incidents, and our response actions — so you're always in control.

reasons.title: You can't hire your way out of this problem.
reasons.description: A true 24/7 SOC requires 6–8 skilled analysts minimum. MDR gives you that capability at a fraction of the cost — without the recruiting headache.

reasons.title: Speed is the difference between an incident and a disaster.
reasons.description: The longer an attacker lives in your network, the more they take. Our AI detects and responds in minutes, not months.

reasons.title: Cyber insurance demands it.
reasons.description: Most carriers now require active monitoring as a condition of coverage — or they'll price you out if you don't have it.

reasons.title: Your board is asking about detection capability.
reasons.description: After every high-profile breach in the news, leadership wants answers. MDR is the answer.

reasons.title: Asset visibility powers everything.
reasons.description: Powered by enterprise asset intelligence, we map every device and dependency in your environment before we write a single detection rule. That's why our signal-to-noise ratio is industry-leading.

cta.title: See What's Hiding in Your Network.
cta.description: A free threat assessment reveals gaps before attackers do.

services.title: Compliance Advisory
services.intro: Regulations are getting stricter, more complex, and more numerous every year. Security Dawgs translates the legal language into the specific actions your business needs to take — and keeps you there.
services.problemTitle: Compliance Failure Costs More Than Compliance.
services.problemDescription: A failed audit can kill an enterprise deal. A regulatory fine can crater a quarter. A lapsed certification can end a vendor relationship overnight. Security Dawgs keeps you audit-ready — not just at renewal time, but always.

pillars.title: Regulatory Mastery
pillars.description: SOC 2. HIPAA. PCI-DSS. GDPR. CMMC. State-level privacy laws. We live in this world so you don't have to. We make complex regulatory requirements simple, specific, and actionable — and we keep you audit-ready year-round.

pillars.title: Bespoke Risk Alignment
pillars.description: A healthcare company and a fintech have the same GDPR obligations but completely different risk profiles. We align your compliance program to your industry's actual threat landscape — not a generic framework copy-pasted from a template.

pillars.title: Ongoing Assurance
pillars.description: Regulations change. Your business changes. Your compliance posture needs to change with them. We continuously monitor the regulatory landscape and evolve your strategy — so a new rule never catches you off guard.

reasons.title: Compliance is often what unlocks the deal.
reasons.description: Enterprise customers and regulated-industry buyers demand proof of compliance before signing. Your SOC 2 report is a sales tool.

reasons.title: The regulatory landscape is too fragmented to navigate alone.
reasons.description: Overlapping, sometimes conflicting frameworks across jurisdictions require expertise most companies don't have in-house.

reasons.title: Audit failure has direct revenue consequences.
reasons.description: Failed audits mean lost contracts, lost partners, and in some sectors, the inability to legally operate.

reasons.title: Most companies don't lack will — they lack translation.
reasons.description: We turn "what the regulation says" into "what you need to do on your specific network, with your specific vendors."

reasons.title: Compliance doesn't end at the audit.
reasons.description: Passing once doesn't mean you stay compliant. Our ongoing assurance model means you're protected between audits, not just during them.

services.title: Security Awareness Training
services.intro: Your firewall can't stop an employee from clicking the wrong link. Security Dawgs training turns your workforce from your biggest vulnerability into your strongest line of defense.
services.problemTitle: 91% of Attacks Start with a Human.
services.problemDescription: Phishing. Social engineering. Weak passwords. Credential handoffs. The most expensive breaches in history started with a single click. You can't firewall your way out of human error — you have to train it out.

pillars.title: Engaging Education
pillars.description: Forget the 45-minute click-through video that everyone skips. Our interactive training is built to hold attention, challenge thinking, and stick. When training is something people actually do, it actually works.

pillars.title: Behavior Change Focus
pillars.description: Awareness without behavior change is just trivia. We build programs that drive real, lasting changes in how your people handle email, credentials, and suspicious requests — because knowing the right thing and doing the right thing are two different problems.

pillars.title: Measurable Results
pillars.description: We track phishing simulation click rates, reporting rates, quiz scores, and behavior trends over time. You get a clear picture of exactly how your organization's security posture is improving — and what still needs work.

reasons.title: People are the actual attack surface.
reasons.description: The vast majority of breaches start with a human action — not a zero-day exploit. Your team is the target.

reasons.title: One bad click undoes everything else.
reasons.description: You can have best-in-class MDR and full compliance certification, and one employee handing over credentials in a phishing email resets the board.

reasons.title: Insurance and compliance frameworks require it.
reasons.description: PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, and most cyber insurance policies explicitly mandate documented, recurring security training.

reasons.title: It's a liability and due diligence issue.
reasons.description: "We trained our staff" is a materially different position in litigation and insurance claims than "we did nothing."

reasons.title: Standard training doesn't work — ours does.
reasons.description: Most mandatory training is boring checkbox theater that employees click through without retaining anything. We measure behavior change, not completion rates.
